## ICAN v0.1.0

This release starts the public version series at **0.1.0** with the latest ICAN implementation. It retains the canvas, AI text/image/video workflows, private media, account synchronization and 3D Director, together with the security and API-configuration changes. Identify this build by its source commit and immutable image digest; an older image previously used the same version label.

### Supplier templates

Administrators can add, edit, import, export and delete templates in **Admin → Settings → Supplier templates**. Users select one in the existing **Add custom API** dialog and enter their own key. Reopening the selector discovers changes without recompilation. Templates initialize new channels; later edits do not overwrite saved personal configurations.

Each supplier has a separate file in the persistent `api-templates` directory. Personal imports can follow the user's account. Templates contain no keys, and the public release includes no private supplier definitions, destinations, models or remote template subscription. The existing request engine, permission checks, outbound restrictions and media authorization remain in use.

[Template usage](https://github.com/ruoyeyu/ICAN/blob/main/docs/security/supplier-templates.md)

### Prebuilt image

Platform: **Linux / amd64**. Source: `53f8aa31d8fd803668cc138b3d91262ea9903c89`.

```sh
docker pull ghcr.io/ruoyeyu/ican@sha256:79e0eec12706e735ccf8243776944abc339d677e9b27d29fa7c8152934ab3887
```

Set `ICAN_IMAGE` to the full digest above in the existing protected deployment environment file. The server only pulls and runs the image; it does not compile the application.

CPU and memory settings are at the top of the attached environment example and Compose file:

```dotenv
ICAN_CPUS=1.6
ICAN_MEMORY=1536m
```

These are editable examples (1536m = 1.5 GiB), not a universal server size. Recreate the container to apply changes; a plain restart does not apply new limits. Additional swap stays disabled. Preserve the existing `ICAN_DATA_DIR`, `DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY`, `JWT_SECRET` and other operator settings. When upgrading, add the two resource variables to your existing environment file; do not replace it with the example.

Use the attached source-matched Compose and checker: validate `config --quiet`, create with `--no-build`, check the stopped container with matching `--cpus` and `--memory`, then start. [Pull, start, update and rollback](https://github.com/ruoyeyu/ICAN/blob/main/docs/security/ghcr-deployment.md)

Back up the entire data directory, including the database, media and `api-templates`, with the original configuration and keys. Retain the previous image digest and matching backup for rollback. No workflow deploys or changes a server.

### Checks

Go tests, 31 web tests, 294 Director tests, dependency audits, production builds, 9 deployment/publication policy checks, image isolation, account/template restart recovery, native runtime regressions and both Compose configurations passed. The complete image scan has 0 critical/high/medium/low matches and one retained UNKNOWN module advisory whose affected OpenPGP packages are not imported by this build. Effective reviewed findings: 0. No scan filters or failure bypasses were added.

The attachments include the publication manifest, complete scan/SBOM/runtime/Compose evidence, source-matched deployment files and SHA256 checksums. [CI run](https://github.com/ruoyeyu/ICAN/actions/runs/40184337184)

Existing production acceptance items for resource boundaries, session credentials, data recovery and host configuration remain recorded in [todo.md](https://github.com/ruoyeyu/ICAN/blob/main/docs/progress/todo.md).

## 简体中文

本次把包含最新功能的公开版本重新编号为 **0.1.0**，保留画布、图文视频流程、私人素材、账号同步、导演台及已有安全修复。请用源码 commit 和镜像 digest 区分构建，不沿用早期同名版本的镜像。

后台可独立新增、编辑、导入、导出和删除供应商模板。用户在原“新增自定义 API”选择器中选模板，填写自己的 Key 即可添加渠道；重新打开选择器就能发现模板变化，不需要重新编译。后台模板更新不会覆盖用户已保存配置。个人导入的模板可随账号同步。

**公共版本不预装私有供应商的方法、地址、模型或凭据。** 每个站点由管理员或本地 Agent 自行添加。仍使用原调用引擎、账号权限、出站检查和素材授权机制。[模板使用方法](https://github.com/ruoyeyu/ICAN/blob/main/docs/security/supplier-templates.zh-CN.md)

服务器直接拉取上方镜像，无需编译。在现有环境文件顶部添加或修改 `ICAN_CPUS=1.6`、`ICAN_MEMORY=1536m`（1.5 GiB），可以按机器规格调整。修改后重建、检查并启动容器；不需要重新构建镜像。继续使用原数据目录和加密密钥，不覆盖原环境文件。

更新前备份数据库、媒体、模板目录、部署配置和原密钥，保留旧 digest 与匹配备份。操作步骤见 [部署、更新和回滚](https://github.com/ruoyeyu/ICAN/blob/main/docs/security/ghcr-deployment.zh-CN.md)。本次发布不操作服务器，不调用付费生成 API。
